source.version: main snapshot reviewed 2026-07-21; no tagged release

capabilities.title: Lead with the action or answer instead of a preamble
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Available through the existing opt-in Direct persona.

capabilities.title: Use numbered steps and keep lists short
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Direct mode uses numbered sequence when order matters and caps lists at five.

capabilities.title: End with one concrete next action
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The Direct response contract exposes one resumption point.

capabilities.title: Suppress tangents unless they block the task
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Direct mode keeps blockers but removes optional branches.

capabilities.title: Restate current state and make completed progress visible
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Direct mode makes recovery state visible without forced praise.

capabilities.title: Use concrete estimates and matter-of-fact errors
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus only permits estimates grounded in available evidence and forbids invented precision.

capabilities.title: Apply the skill globally under a health-related label
capabilities.reason: Nexus keeps the behavior opt-in and explicitly does not infer, mention, or persist a diagnosis.

capabilities.title: Install the upstream Markdown skill as a separate package
capabilities.reason: The useful behavior fits the existing Direct persona and does not require an external installation.
